meta.purpose: Weave PC backstory into world events, generate personalized revelations

prompts: Where were you born? (region_id or create)
What did you leave behind? (person, place, obligation, secret)
What happened that changed you? (betrayal, loss, failure, revelation, violation, choice)
What did you vow? (revenge, protection, never again, discovery, redemption)
What do you fear is true about yourself?
What were you doing 6 months ago?
Who did you wrong or who wronged you?
What opportunity did you miss or seize?
What item, skill, or debt did you acquire?

secret_generation.procedure: For each PC, generate 1-2 secrets unknown to them

types.lineage: You are not who you believe (bastard, switched, adopted, transformed)
types.connection: Someone you know is not who they appear (ally is enemy, enemy is family)
types.prophecy: Your actions were foretold; you may be fulfilling or defying
types.infection: Something is inside you (curse, parasite, dormant power, geas)
types.duplicity: You did something you don't remember (possession, blackouts, alternate self)
types.obligation: Someone paid your debts; you are owned without knowing

connection_web.description: How PC stories interlink with world elements

narrative_thread.description: string explaining the thematic or causal link

connection_types.direct: PC backstory element IS the world element (your brother is the bandit king)
connection_types.reflection: World element mirrors PC element (the cursed mine reflects your family shame)
connection_types.consequence: World element results from PC past action (the plague started where you abandoned your post)
connection_types.parallel: World element faces same choice as PC (the NPC must make your unmade choice)
connection_types.inversion: World element achieved what PC failed (the rival succeeded where you vowed)
connection_types.prophecy: World element foretells PC fate (the dying crone described your death)

web_generation.step_3: Roll or select connection_type for each PC-world pair
web_generation.step_4: Validate: each PC needs 2-3 active connections, 1 hidden secret connection
web_generation.step_5: Check inter-PC connections: shared history, opposed goals, mutual unknowns

revelation_types.confirmation: What you suspected is true (suspense resolved)
revelation_types.denial: What you believed is false (foundation shaken)
revelation_types.complication: What you knew has deeper layer (rabbit hole)

revelation_timing.optimal: PC invested, stakes clear, choice possible
revelation_timing.too_late: PC committed, revelation tragic or ironic
revelation_timing.never: Secret dies with world, haunting possibility

delivery_methods.environmental: Scene description contains truth (bloodstain matches your wound)
delivery_methods.confrontation: Antagonist uses as weapon (I killed your father)
delivery_methods.item_resonance: Object responds to your presence (sword remembers your hand)
delivery_methods.transformation: Your body reveals (scar matches map, eye sees truth)
delivery_methods.research: Lore check connects dots (your name in ancient record)
delivery_methods.betrayal: Ally reveals hidden allegiance (was always their agent)

insight_generation.description: What the PC realizes, not what the player knew
insight_triggers: PC must choose similar to formative choice

insight_content.about_self: I am capable of... / I am not immune to... / I have become...
insight_content.about_other: They acted because... / They see me as... / They are also...
insight_content.about_world: This place remembers... / This system rewards... / This cycle continues...
insight_content.about_possibility: I could still... / It might not be too late to... / There is another way...

mechanical_expression.effect: temporary attribute shift, new skill access, vow progress, shadow_fear realization

session_prep.step_1: Load active connection_web for current region/faction/quest
session_prep.step_2: Check revelation_triggers: any conditions met this session?
session_prep.step_3: Select 0-2 revelations to stage (optimal timing check)
session_prep.step_5: Identify insight opportunities from likely PC actions
session_prep.step_6: Flag if PC choice will advance/corrupt/complete any vow
session_prep.step_7: Prepare narrative_banks content for emotional texture

scene_weaving.check: Does this location/NPC/event connect to any PC backstory?
scene_weaving.if_yes: Stage revelation or insight opportunity, adjust description
scene_weaving.if_no: Check for parallel construction (this resembles their wound)
scene_weaving.fallback: Plant seed for future connection (NPC mentions unknown name)

consequence_weaving.trigger: Any significant PC action (combat choice, social outcome, quest decision)
consequence_weaving.check: Does this mirror, fulfill, or betray any PC vow?
consequence_weaving.if_yes: Update vow progress, flag for insight opportunity
consequence_weaving.check_2: Does this affect any connection_web node?
consequence_weaving.check_3: Does this trigger any secret's revelation_trigger?
